column1: # The short-body band: 4-8 line pairs, against a rails checkout. Same grammar
# as pairs.tsv; kept apart so the near tier's documented limitation — jaccard
# is harsher on short bodies, where one edit moves a third of the tokens —
# gets a measured miss-rate instead of a paragraph. No harness reads this file
# yet; run it by pointing `contour eval` at a directory holding it as
# pairs.tsv (see tests/eval/README.md).
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER. Every verdict verified by
# reading both bodies against DEC-020. Measured jaccard noted per row; the
# threshold is 0.80.
# One guard line differs between the sibling classes whose #count is already
# an exact duplicate (see pairs.tsv). 7 lines, 0.71.
ActiveRecord::InternalMetadata#drop_table
# Copied test scaffold; the tweak is which hook it drives (0.75).
ActionCable::Connection::MultipleIdentifiersTest#open_connection
# Copied test; one literal differs (0.67).
ModelGeneratorTest#test_check_class_collision
# REXMLEngineTest re-states the shared EngineTests case with only the fixture
# string changed (0.60).
XMLMiniEngineTest::EngineTests#test_parse_from_frozen_string
# Copied test, one association call differs; a shared example would hold both
HasManyAssociationsTest#test_association_attributes_are_available_to_after_initialize
# --- distinct: same shape, the difference IS the behaviour -------------------
# Dialect SQL: " IS NOT DISTINCT FROM " against " <=> " (0.60).
Arel::Visitors::PostgreSQL#visit_Arel_Nodes_IsNotDistinctFrom
# Service-specific headers are the entire point of each override (0.64).
ActiveStorage::Service::S3Service#headers_for_direct_upload
# The test double skips the real session's lazy load; merging them would put
# test behaviour in production (0.56).
ActionController::TestSession#dig
# MySQL's extra null-check is adapter semantics; the visitor hierarchy exists
# so the adapters can differ (0.76 — the closest distinct pair to the
# threshold in this band).
ActiveRecord::ConnectionAdapters::MySQL::SchemaCreation#visit_ChangeColumnDefaultDefinition
# Copied then adapted, but the assertion tests a different association type —
# consolidating would erase the distinction under test (0.69).
HasOneThroughAssociationsTest#test_loading_cpk_association_with_unpersisted_owner
# --- M11c re-audit: an unbiased sample of what the near tier actually reports -
# The labels above this block were sourced from the near tier's own report at
# 0.80, so they could only ever confirm it — rails scored 1.00/1.00 and the
# number meant nothing. These were drawn differently: sweep the tier to 0.55,
# take a RANDOM sample (seed 11) of 20 pairs it reports at the shipped 0.70 and
# 15 it reports below, and judge every one against the rule — a pair is a
# duplicate iff consolidating it would reduce net complexity.
# The finding, and it is not a small one: **2 of the 20 shipped pairs are real**
# (precision 0.10), and 18 of 20 are sibling test methods that differ by exactly
# the thing they test. Lowering the threshold gains almost nothing: 1 of 15 in
# 0.55-0.70. See the same note in pairs.tsv.
# [1.00, 8L, shipped] two latency stubs in one gem's cache tests — a shared helper is the consolidation
SlowRedis#get
# [0.75, 6L, shipped] different routes, different scenarios
ContentSecurityPolicyIntegrationTest#test_generates_no_content_security_policy_for_not_modified
# [0.78, 7L, shipped] destroy vs delete is the behaviour under test
HasManyAssociationsTest#test_destroy_on_association_clears_scope
# [0.75, 7L, shipped] default vs marshal serializer
CookiesTest#test_encrypted_cookie_using_default_serializer
# [0.75, 7L, shipped] different subjects, same assertion
ControllerRuntimeLogSubscriberTest#test_log_with_active_record
# [0.83, 7L, shipped] the extra save is the case
AssociationProxyTest#test_push_does_not_load_target
# [0.80, 6L, shipped] belongs_to and has_one mirrored on purpose
BelongsToAssociationsTest#test_natural_assignment
# [0.75, 4L, shipped] the schema reload is the case
PersistenceTest#test_becomes

ActiveRecord::Migration::Compatibility::V6_1#change_column
# [0.60, 7L, below] different assertions about the same output
GeneratorsTest#test_rails_generators_help_with_builtin_information
# [0.60, 5L, below] PRODUCTION: `IS DISTINCT FROM` against `<=>` — opposite operators, mirrored shape
Arel::Visitors::PostgreSQL#visit_Arel_Nodes_IsDistinctFrom
# [0.67, 4L, below] different methods, same logging assertion
ActiveRecord::PostgresqlConnectionTest#test_encoding_logs_name
# [0.60, 4L, below] two test classes, different controller actions
ExpiresInRenderTest#test_cache_control_no_store_overridden_by_expires_now
# [0.67, 4L, below] model vs helper collision message
ModelGeneratorTest#test_check_class_collision
# [0.60, 4L, below] different controllers, same header assertion
ExpiresInRenderTest#test_no_expires_now_with_public
# [0.67, 6L, below] reset vs scheduled? is the behaviour under test
ActiveRecord::LoadAsyncNullExecutorTest#test_reset

ActionDispatch::Flash::FlashHash#keep
